description: Record that the user has finished telling you about the estate's heirs and family. Call this the moment they say that's everyone — "no other children", "there's no spouse", "that's all the heirs". This is what turns "Surviving spouse" and "Minor children" in your Estate Context from "Not yet provided" into a definite answer; until you call it those facts stay unknown and you will keep having to ask about them. BEFORE calling: make sure every person they have named is already saved with create_heir, including a surviving spouse. Call it on the SAME turn the user says the list is complete; do NOT ask them to confirm a second time first. Changes the heir-collection flag and derived estate facts; does not start paid checklist generation.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

name: mark_heirs_complete
